items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: So Clarence and I had this big argument and said we'll break up... I had the original band, which I did have -- the band went with me.

ctx.x: Washington, D.C. So, Clarence came back and said, 'I heard a group last night that was terrific.' So I went down to hear them and sure enough there was this group, and the group was headed by Elmer Snowden, he was a banjo player, and in the band was a youngster playing piano, and his name was Duke Ellington. They always nicknamed him Duke because of his heir, with Edward Kennedy.
